verdict.rationale: SigNoz ships an official MCP server and Agent Skills that give natural-language access to metrics, logs and traces, and the skills explicitly generate queries and ClickHouse SQL. Its AI use-cases docs also list dashboard creation from natural language. The caveat is that this only works through an external AI agent such as Claude, Cursor or Copilot. Nothing in the evidence shows a native natural-language query box inside the SigNoz UI, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: native in-product NL query/chart experience, detail on how generated queries and charts are returned to the user, independent or hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Query metrics, traces, logs, alerts, and dashboards through natural language.
generate queries over traces, logs, and metrics, write ClickHouse queries, create and modify dashboards
Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.
